extras.notes: straight sturdy ash staff, identical at both ends: domed brass caps with a decorative groove and star rivets; two leather-wrapped grips between brass rings and a red cloth band in the middle; symmetrical, lies flat (z = 0), long axis = X; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
